title: Fate Intertwined
next_chapter_hook: When what came through the blood resonance was not killing intent, but an uncanny sense of familiarity, Chen Ji suddenly realized—between this Demonic Path Commander and himself, there might exist a fate entanglement far more complex than mere enmity.

text.content: Dark night like ink, cold wind carrying bone-piercing killing intent. Chen Ji stood in place, his pupils reflecting the figure slowly emerging. That face—that was a face he knew too well, yet should never have appeared at this moment. Moonlight pierced through the treetops, illuminating the newcomer's silhouette, and a bone-deep blood pulse sensation exploded within him like thunder.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji— Ye Qing's suppressed voice came from behind, That's the Demonic Path Commander. His aura... I've never felt such terrifying oppression. Her voice carried a tremor, clearly also intimidated by this imposing presence.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer. At this moment, all his attention focused on that blood resonance—the sensation felt too familiar, familiar enough to make his heart race. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace grew slightly warm, as if warning him of something. He drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions, his expression returning to its customary indifference.

dialogue.content: Honored guest, what brings you here in the deep of night? Chen Ji's voice was平静得近乎冷漠，仿佛眼前并非足以毁灭一切的魔道主帅，而只是一个无关紧要的路人。他微微侧身，将夜清挡在身后半步的位置。

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander didn't answer immediately. He simply stood there, ten zhang away, his black robe billowing violently in the night wind, deep-set eyes locked死死盯着陈机，仿佛要看穿他所有的秘密。空气在这一刻变得粘稠起来，陈机感觉自己的呼吸都沉重了几分。

dialogue.content: Your bloodline... The Demonic Path Commander finally spoke, his voice low and hoarse, carries the same resonance as mine. In this world, those who possess such pure blood are exceedingly rare... His gaze suddenly turned sharp, Who exactly are you?

text.content: These words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. His hand unconsciously pressed toward his chest, where the Tianji Record Fragment lay hidden, along with all the secrets of the Chen family's bloodline. Blood resonance—he had long sensed some extraordinary power flowing through his veins, yet never imagined it would be perceived by another bearer under such circumstances.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander's pressing question hung over Chen Ji like a blade suspended at his crown. He had to make a choice—whether to reveal his identity and trigger a greater crisis, or continue concealing it to plan his next move.

choices.text: Attack as a form of defense, counter-asking the other's identity
choices.description: Avoid a direct answer, using counter-questions to probe the Demonic Path Commander's true intentions while observing his reactions.
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's strength runs deep and unfathomable—any misjudgment could lead to catastrophic consequences
choices.process_label: 以其人之道还治其人之身

dialogue.content: Since you can sense the bloodline fluctuation, you must be well-versed in the Chen family's history. A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips, his tone carrying a hint of amusement. I wonder, honored elder—did someone send you here tonight, or do you come with... other intentions?

text.content: This move of retreating while advancing proved effective. A flash of surprise flickered in the Demonic Path Commander's eyes, clearly not expecting such boldness from this so-called waste. Ye Qing beside him secretly relaxed, yet dared not be the slightest bit negligent.

choices.text: Exploit Ye Qing's connection, use the internal contradictions within the Demonic faction to escape
choices.description: Hint at Ye Qing's relationship with the Holy Sect, exposing that the Demonic faction is not monolithic, dismantling the enemy's oppressive momentum.
choices.risk_hint: Once Ye Qing's identity is exposed, she will become a target for the Demonic faction's pursuit

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's eyes flashed; his voice, though not loud, was clear enough for everyone present to hear: Since the honored elder comes from the Holy Sect, surely you show no mercy to 'renegades.' He slightly shifted his body, pushing Ye Qing to the forefront, I wonder... how does this person intend to handle her?

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander's pupils contracted sharply. He clearly hadn't anticipated that Chen Ji would know Ye Qing's identity, let alone that he would expose it so directly. Ye Qing's body stiffened, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying more complicated emotions.

choices.text: Trigger the Tianji Record, foresee key variables within the next three hours
choices.description: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate, activate the foresight ability of the Tianji Record Fragment, seeking the key to breaking the deadlock through bloodline resonance.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is extremely precious, and the aura of the Tianji Record may be detected by the opponent

text.content: Chen Ji's mind stirred, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace suddenly burned hot. In an instant, countless images flashed through his mind like a revolving lantern—blood, war flames, a familiar figure... and a vague yet shocking truth. His pupils contracted sharply, and his breath stopped completely at that moment.

dialogue.content: "Impossible..." Chen Ji's voice carried a rare tremor, "You are... Chen Nian? No, that's impossible!" He sharply raised his head, his gaze firmly locked on the familiar face of the Demonic Path Commander, the image of his long-missing sister emerging in his mind.

text.content: Bloodline resonance reached its peak at this moment. That familiar sensation was no longer a vague感应, but clearly pointed to a possibility he had never imagined.

The Demonic Path Commander's footsteps stopped five zhang away. He did not continue to advance, but the flames burning in those eyes grew even more intense. The night wind blew past, carrying a nauseating scent of blood. Chen Ji knew it was the remnant of the battlefield, yet it seemed exceptionally pungent at this moment.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, let me go first." Ye Qing quietly gathered demonic energy, her voice extremely low, "His attention is entirely on you—this is our only chance." Her fingertips had already begun to glow faintly purple, the precursor to Demonic Path mist.

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond to Ye Qing's suggestion. His entire mind was occupied by that bloodline resonance. Strangely, what came from the opponent was not hostility or killing intent, but an indescribable sense of familiarity—like looking into a mirror, or like reuniting with a loved one across time and space.

dialogue.content: "This bloodline... this seat has investigated it for a full ten years." The Demonic Path Commander's voice suddenly softened, "Ten years ago, on the night of the Chen family's destruction, this seat sensed the existence of this bloodline. I thought it was merely a fortunate escaped branch, but never expected..." His gaze became complicated, "You are actually of the main line."

text.content: Main line. Chen Ji's heart sank sharply. What this term meant, he knew better than anyone. The main line blood of the Chen family was the key to opening a certain long-sealed door. And what lay behind that door was enough to drive the entire cultivation world mad. He suddenly understood why the Demonic Path Commander had appeared in person.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander revealed the secret of the Chen family's main line bloodline, making the situation increasingly complex. Chen Ji must decide how to handle this situation—whether to continue testing the opponent's bottom line, or reveal more trump cards in exchange for negotiating capital.

choices.text: Reveal the Chen Nian card, exchange it for the opponent's honesty
choices.description: Directly mention the name of his sister Chen Nian, observe the Demonic Path Commander's reaction, thereby judging the opponent's degree of involvement in Chen Nian's disappearance.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information, judge friend or foe
choices.risk_hint: Once the opponent is connected to Chen Nian's disappearance, you will fall into complete passivity

dialogue.content: "Since the senior has investigated for ten years, surely you know more about Chen family affairs than I do." Chen Ji's voice cooled several degrees, "Then I would ask—do you know the whereabouts of the girl taken away by the Holy Sect ten years ago?"

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander's form clearly stiffened for an instant. That fleeting moment of loss of composure did not escape Chen Ji's eyes, yet it also made his heart sink to the bottom of the valley—the opponent was indeed connected to Chen Nian.

choices.text: Propose cooperation, using bloodline to check bloodline
choices.description: Utilize both parties' common need for bloodline power, propose a temporary cooperation plan, seeking the possibility of mutual benefit in chaotic times.
choices.visible_cost: May need to share bloodline secrets
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally or key intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The words of those on the Demonic Path cannot be fully trusted; one may be betrayed at any moment
choices.process_label: 以利益为纽带，化敌为友

dialogue.content: "What the senior needs is merely the bloodline power." Chen Ji stepped forward, his voice steady. "What I need is a backer who can help me survive the conflicts among the three great sects. Rather than drawing swords against each other, why not each take what we need?"

text.content: The Demonic Path commander fell silent for a moment, then let out a low chuckle: "Interesting. This one has wandered the cultivation world for hundreds of years, yet this is the first time a junior has negotiated with me in such a manner." His tone actually carried a hint of appreciation. "Tell me your terms."

Ye Qing's tense nerves finally relaxed a fraction. She gazed at Chen Ji's retreating figure, her eyes flickering with a complex light—this man always displayed his astonishing scheming in places she least expected.

Just as the atmosphere slightly eased, the Tianji Record Fragment burned with another urgent warning. Chen Ji's brow furrowed, an inexplicable unease rising in his heart. He suddenly realized—if the Demonic Path commander was truly an enemy, with the other's strength and status, there was absolutely no need to appear personally, nor to waste words under the moonlight with him.

dialogue.content: "Be careful—" Ye Qing suddenly cried out. Chen Ji looked up to see several streaks of light blazing across the distant horizon, hurtling toward them at an astonishing speed. That aura, he knew intimately—it was the reinforcements from Tianqing Sect!

text.content: The Demonic Path commander glanced upward, a meaningful smile curving his lips: "It seems tonight is destined not to be peaceful." He redirected his gaze back to Chen Ji. "The Tianqing Sect's people arrive at a convenient time. This one wonders how long you can maintain your act of 'waste' before them."

These words struck Chen Ji like a basin of cold water. He instantly understood the commander's intention—the Demonic Path commander didn't need to lift a finger at all. He simply needed to wait here and expose Chen Ji's identity before Tianqing Sect. Then, even with a thousand tricks up his sleeve, Chen Ji would have nowhere to use them. This was the true checkmate.

choice.prompt: The Tianqing Sect reinforcements were approaching, and the Demonic Path commander's trap had already taken shape. Chen Ji found himself in an unprecedented predicament—force a breakout, or find another way out?

choices.text: Request Ye Qing to cover the retreat with Demonic Mist
choices.description: Have Ye Qing施展魔道迷雾技能遮掩气息，趁援军未至之前遁入夜色之中。
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Mist would expose Ye Qing's Demonic Path identity, making her a target for all

dialogue.content: "Go!" Chen Ji whispered sharply. Without a moment's hesitation, Ye Qing unleashed a wave of purple Demonic Mist that instantly enveloped both their forms, shrouding them completely.

text.content: Yet the moment the mist rose, the Demonic Path commander's voice rang out once more: "An interesting ability. Unfortunately—" His figure vanished on the spot, and the next instant he had appeared at the edge of the mist. "Before This One, nothing can be completely concealed."

choices.text: Activate hidden trump card, make the Demonic Path commander pay the price
choices.description: Reveal some protective手段墨先生留下的防护手段，强行与魔道主帅对峙，逼对方重新评估形势。
choices.risk_hint: Once the trump card is exposed, it loses its mystery, and future plans may be affected

text.content: A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. His left hand reached into his robe, fingers brushing against a hidden rune pattern on the Tianji Record Fragment. A surge of ancient and vast power instantly awakened—that was the final protection left by Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: "Does the senior truly believe that in all these years, I Chen Ji have only been sweeping the sect grounds?" Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold and stern. "Some things, I never wished to use. Since the senior insists on pressing—"

text.content: Before the words finished, a brilliant golden light burst forth from Chen Ji's body, directly forcing the Demonic Path commander back three steps. In that instant, even Ye Qing showed stunned disbelief—she had never witnessed Chen Ji display such power before.

choices.text: Honestly confess everything to the Demonic Path commander, in exchange for true cooperation
choices.description: Abandon all pretense, reveal his identity, the Tianji Record, and the search for Chen Nian completely, trading sincerity for sincerity.
choices.visible_reward: May gain true allies and leads
choices.risk_hint: Once the other party proves untrustworthy, it will be eternal doom

dialogue.content: "Alright, I'll lay my cards on the table." Chen Ji took a deep breath. "I am indeed a direct descendant of the Chen Family. The Tianji Record is in my possession, and my sister was taken by the Holy Sect ten years ago, her whereabouts unknown until now. What the senior wants, I can give, but I must see Chen Nian first."

text.content: A strange glint flickered in the demonic path commander-in-chief's eyes. He seemed unprepared for Chen Ji to reveal all his trump cards so directly. After a moment, he suddenly laughed: "Interesting. In all my years, this is the first time I've met such an intriguing young man."
"However—" The demonic path commander-in-chief's tone suddenly shifted, "Are you certain you wish to know Chen Nian's whereabouts? Some truths, once known, can never be taken back."

The distant escaping light grew closer by the moment—at most half a cup of tea's time before arrival. Chen Ji stood motionless, letting the demonic path commander-in-chief's words echo in his ears. That familiar sensation from the blood resonance still lingered in his heart, impossible to dispel. He suddenly realized something—the other party's body carried a faint scent similar to Chen Nian's.
"You and Chen Nian..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. "What exactly is the relationship?" This question he had to ask, even if the answer might completely overturn his understanding.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stood nearby, watching Chen Ji display such an expression—a complex surge of emotions rose in her heart. This was the first time she had seen this man so unnerved, yet also the first time she sensed that hidden vulnerability deep within him, a vulnerability never shown to others.

text.content: "Relationship?" The demonic path commander-in-chief softly repeated the word, then let out a profound sigh. "Perhaps the answer to this question is heavier than you can imagine." He raised his hand, pointing to his own face that bore some resemblance to Chen Ji's. "What do you think? Do we look... alike?"

Alike. The word struck Chen Ji's mind like thunder. Under the moonlight, the demonic path commander-in-chief's features gradually overlapped with a face from memory—that was his father's youthful appearance. No, not just similar, but as if carved from the same mold. His breathing became utterly chaotic at this moment.

dialogue.content: "That night the Chen Family was destroyed, this one was not present." The demonic path commander-in-chief's voice suddenly grew low. "By the time this one rushed back, everything was already too late. Chen Nian... she was taken by the Holy Sect, and this one has pursued for ten years, yet failed to rescue her."

text.content: Chen Ji shuddered violently. Pursued for ten years but couldn't rescue Chen Nian? With the demonic path commander-in-chief's strength and status, if he truly wanted to save someone, how could he possibly fail for a decade? Unless... He raised his head sharply, an even more terrifying thought emerging in his mind—unless Chen Nian herself didn't want to be rescued, or something forced her to remain in the Holy Sect.

"You are a Chen Family member." Chen Ji's voice was bitter, each word seemingly squeezed from between his teeth. "Which generation of the Chen Family do you belong to?" This question, he already had an answer to. Someone possessing such pure bloodline and such resemblance to his father could only be one possibility.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing finally understood something. Her gaze toward the demonic path commander-in-chief held more complex emotions—if the other party truly was Chen Ji's blood relative, then the nature of this confrontation had completely changed. She quietly withdrew the demonic energy in her hand, preparing to observe the situation.

text.content: "This one's name—" The demonic path commander-in-chief's voice suddenly became distant, "Chen Tianji." The moment this name emerged, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Tianji, the Tianji Record—the connection between these two words became crystal clear at this moment. He suddenly understood why Mo Xiansheng had guarded the Tianji Record Fragment, understood the true reason for the Chen Family's destruction, and understood the heaviness of the fate he himself carried.

Chen Tianji—that was the Chen Family's previous generation Heavenly Fate Prophet, also the chosen inheritor of the Tianji Record, yet was abandoned by the Tianji Record after Chen Ji's birth, deemed a "more suitable vessel." He should have been the master of the Tianji Record, only to be stripped of everything by an infant at the final moment. This person abandoned by fate clawed his way out of ruins over twenty years, becoming the demonic path commander-in-chief.

"Now you know." Chen Tianji's voice was平静得近乎冷漠，"This one investigates the bloodline to find a method to completely destroy the Tianji Record. And you—" his gaze如刀般锐利，"are the inheritor this one must eliminate." As the words fell, killing intent骤然弥漫。然而奇怪的是，那股血脉共鸣中传来的，却依然是某种难以言喻的熟悉感，仿佛在告诉他，眼前这个人，并非纯粹的敌人。"Now you know." Chen Tianji's voice was calm to the point of coldness. "This one investigates the bloodline to find a method to completely destroy the Tianji Record. And you—" his gaze was like a blade, "are the inheritor this one must eliminate." The words fell, and killing intent suddenly filled the air. Yet strangely, from that blood resonance came an indescribable familiarity, as if telling him that the person before him was not a pure enemy.
